findings: Database migration missing — Schema changes in models.py (country_code, source_type, category length, indexes) require an Alembic migration. Run `alembic revision --autogenerate -m "global aqi support"` and `alembic upgrade head`.

Country code backfill needed — Existing Indian cities have `country_code = NULL`. When AQI is calculated for these cities, resolver returns "unavailable" instead of CPCB. Run `UPDATE locations SET country_code = 'IN' WHERE country = 'India';` after schema migration.

CO unit conversion assumption undocumented — US EPA calculator assumes database stores CO in µg/m³ and converts to ppm by dividing by 1,145,000. If the database stores mg/m³ (which CPCB uses), the conversion is wrong by 1000x. Verify actual database unit and adjust or document.

Coverage hours display shows "null h" — Frontend pollutant cards display "null h of data" when coverage_hours is None (US EPA and European methodologies). Conditionally render the coverage line only when coverage_hours is not null.

Verification evidence incomplete — verification.md reports "could not run tests due to missing pytest installation" and "could not verify TypeScript compilation due to missing node_modules". Without test execution, CPCB preservation claim is unverified. Run backend tests and frontend build.

European AQI gauge scale mismatch — European methodology caps AQI at 150 (band 6 → 25 * 6). Gauge assumes 0-500 range and renders 150 at 30% of arc instead of 100%. European "Extremely Poor" should feel like a maximum. Verify gauge component handles variable scales or normalize European bands to 0-500.

Health guidance unavailable for non-CPCB — `guidance_for()` only handles CPCB category names. US/European cities show "Health guidance is hidden because a valid CPCB AQI could not be calculated" even when AQI is available. Extend guidance.py to support all three category systems or map non-CPCB to CPCB equivalents.
